required_basis: declared unit profile and original ordered cohort
source_fallback_order: matched actual accrual if available and complete
current official published tariff with temporal/method scope and user-requested interval midpoint

field_sources.return_flow: commissions.<scheme>_return_flow_amount; grouped service estimate, no blind extra handling
field_sources.extra_courier: Historical financial-day control only; not added to forecast last-mile tariff
field_sources.ads_cpo: finance.balance promotion_with_cost_per_order, crosschecked against qualified Performance data
field_sources.ads_cpc: finance.balance pay_per_click, crosschecked against qualified Performance data
field_sources.cogs: owner input, never replaced by prices.net_price
field_sources.acquiring_amount: product/info/prices acquiring: direct amount per matched product, no inferred percentage or price-ratio projection

guards: No unqualified zero from pending financial_data
Do not relabel forecast as actual charge or final profit
Current tariff not claimed historical actual
Retain incurred non-COGS costs unless actual reversal; expected tariff/refund scenarios explicitly named
Product cost input stays unchanged; denominators explicit per scenario
Missing actual charge triggers authorized tariff fallback rather than unexplained empty result
Do not add historical variable courier/logistics/processing/acquiring charges on top of matched forecast delivery tariffs
Owner rejected tariff inference from sums: use explicit percentage only when returned as percentage, else use explicit API amount
Cancellation type alone must not imply zero reverse logistics or a blanket reverse-tariff charge
Missing official CPO refund rule is unknown, not automatic refund or proven universal nonrefund
Absent Return events in a limited logistic-date window do not establish zero reverse charges
Do not derive final cohort profit from store-day overhead without explicit allocation and scope
Fresh owner-requested run must contain new source HTTP calls and must not reuse earlier money values
A final result is numeric only if every required component is known or an authorized scoped estimate; otherwise provide calculated subtotal plus explicit unresolved component
Keep per-physical-unit cost250 and label per-ordered-unit allocation separately if used; no silent denominator switch
main_cancellation_commission_policy: Official expected net remuneration for noncancelled units; never invent an unobserved cancellation commission charge
conditional_sensitivity: Removed from main result: do not invent cancellation commission liability or a second conditional profit.

event_policy.reverse_logistics: Use matched actual charge/reversal; forecast requires verified scheme and stage applicability. Neither Cancellation nor absent Return proves zero reverse cost.
event_policy.sales_commission: Separate sales remuneration and its actual/expected reversal from advertising CPO.
event_policy.cpo_refund: General cancellation/return policy and time limits not verified in accessible official regulation; do not erase recorded CPO or invent a credit.
event_policy.cpc_refund: Clicks remain a separate service; no automatic sale-outcome reversal. Provider corrections require their own basis.
event_policy.return_processing: Warehouse return processing included in reverse logistics; assess PVZ processing, packaging and storage independently without double count.

owner_inputs.if_missing: Report explicit exclusion of user cost/tax and do not claim net profit

required_outputs.logs: Every HTTP request, response summary, UTC start/end, elapsed_ms, pagination completeness
